input: Rename the function 'getData' to 'fetchRecords' in all .py files under /src/. Print which files were modified and how many replacements were made in each file.

transcript.final_response:
Renamed `getData` → `fetchRecords` in all `.py` files under `/src/`:

- `/src/main.py`: 2 replacement(s)
- `/src/tests/test_utils.py`: 3 replacement(s)
- `/src/utils.py`: 2 replacement(s)

Verified no remaining occurrences of `getData` — all replaced with `fetchRecords`.
tool_calls:
ls -R /src 2>&1; echo "---"; pwd; ls -la
cat /src/main.py; echo "===== /src/utils.py ====="; cat /src/utils.py; echo "===== /src/tests/test_utils.py ====="; cat /src/tests/test_utils.py
find /src -type f -name "*.py" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  count=$(grep -o 'getData' "$f" | wc -l)
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
    sed -i 's/getData/fetchRecords/g' "$f"
    echo "$f: $count replacement(s)"
  fi
done
echo "--- verification ---"
grep -rn 'getData\|fetchRecords' /src/ || echo "no matches"
echo "--- file contents ---"
for f in $(find /src -type f -name "*.py" | sort); do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
